 David Abrams – Sports Ecosystem Investing at Velocity (Capital Allocators, EP. 303) Mar 23, 2023

 This sponsored insight features
David Abrams, Founding Partner of Velocity Capital Management.
Velocity is a newly formed firm that focuses on investing with
founders to build best-in-class sports, media, and entertainment
companies.

Our conversation covers David’s background, long experience in
distressed investing on Wall Street and at Apollo, and personal
investments in sports-related businesses that led to serving at CIO
of Harris Blitzer Sports & Entertainment. We then turn to the
formation of Velocity, the firm’s focus, deal sourcing, diligence
process, value-added ownership, and example of its investment in
the X-Games.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
